newsitem.title: MEXICO: Spain's King Juan Carlos to visit Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Spain's King Juan Carlos to visit Mexico.

text.p: Spain's King Juan Carlos will pay a state visit to Mexico on April 4 and 5 to mark 20 years of diplomatic ties between the two Spanish-speaking nations, Mexico's Foreign Ministry said on Friday.
King Juan Carlos will be accompanied by Queen Sophia. It will be their third visit to Mexico.
Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo invited the Spanish royal couple when he was in Spain on a state visit in January 1996, the ministry said.

They will stay on after the state visit and travel on April 7 to the silver-mining town of Zacatecas, 360 miles (600 km) northwest of Mexico City, to inaugurate, with Zedillo, the First International Congress of the Spanish Language.
